name: SynthStrip (GPU) T1w
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FreeSurfer SynthStrip (mri_synthstrip, deep learning, GPU or CPU) and outputs the brain-extracted image and a binary brain mask.
description: Runs mri_synthstrip from the freesurfer/synthstrip 1.7 container on a single T1-weighted NIfTI. By default it runs on a GPU (the -gpu container with Singularity --nv); set use_gpu to false to run on CPU. Optionally excludes CSF from the mask (no_csf). Use it as a robust, contrast-agnostic brain extraction step before registration or segmentation.

parameters.description: If you would like to compute the immediate boundary of the brain, excluding surrounding CSF, use the no_csf flag.
You can disable GPU usage and fall back to the CPU instead; this may cause processing times to increase anywhere from slightly to considerably.

citations.text: Hoopes A, Mora JS, Dalca AV, Fischl B, Hoffmann M. SynthStrip: skull-stripping for any brain image. NeuroImage 260:119474 (2022).
Kelley W, Ngo N, Dalca AV, Fischl B, Zöllei L, Hoffmann M. Boosting skull-stripping performance for pediatric brain images. 2024 IEEE ISBI, pp. 1-5 (2024).

failure_modes.cause: Neither t1 nor t2 is set in config.json.
failure_modes.fix: Provide exactly one anatomical input (t1 or t2).
